name: Linedata Services SA
summary: Linedata Services S.A. develops and distributes financial software in France and internationally. It provides asset management solutions for TPA's/fund and private equity administrators, ManCos, and asset owners, as well as alternative, institution, and wealth managers. The company also offers solutions for lending and leasing industry, such as commercial lending, and mortgage and syndicated loans, as well as for automotive, consumer, and equipment finance; and personal insurance industry for contingency insurance and pensions. In addition, it provides solutions for advisory and software development; cloud, cybersecurity, and managed services; and research, middle office, and risk. Further, the company offers various technologies, such as Linedata Private Cloud, an end-to-end private cloud solution, enabling clients to run Linedata products in a secure private cloud infrastructure, as well as for security and mobility. Linedata Services S.A. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Neuilly-sur-seine, France.
